$comment: RUN CONFIG — the variable input for ONE calculation run. Edit this (or copy it) to drive a new run via: node process/run.mjs metrics/runs/<thisfile>.json. Lists which metrics + which situations to compute over which replay, plus per-metric params.
title: Economy composition % per player per time, with mirror-by-start-position comparison

input.$note_source: source=actions reuses the already-extracted dump. set source=headless to (re)run spring-headless on demoFile first (see process/lib/headless.mjs). demoFile is also parsed for the player roster (names/faction/skill) when available.

roster.$note: auto = use demo-header parser (tools/demoparser) if installed, else fall back to commander-spawn start positions from the action log. Names require the parser; start positions do not.
